name: Lemon Herb Salmon with Roasted Broccoli
description: A simple weeknight salmon dinner with roasted broccoli and lemon-herb seasoning.
recipeIngredient: 1 large broccoli crown, cut into florets

recipeInstructions.text: Toss the broccoli with 1 tablespoon olive oil and arrange it on a baking sheet.
Brush the salmon with the remaining olive oil and season with garlic, oregano, and lemon.
Add the salmon to the baking sheet and roast for 12 to 15 minutes, until the salmon is cooked through and the broccoli is tender.
